decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The porch and canopy, by reason of their excessive size, bulk, inappropriate design and position at this prominent corner property have an unbalancing effect and constitute an obtrusive feature and over development of the property which is out of character with the surrounding area and the St. Paul's Church Conservation Area. They are therefore contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines and Supplementary Planning Guidance relating to St Paul's Church Conservation Area.

Condition : 2 - 2. The detached garage, by reason of its excessive size, bulk, appearance and position at this prominent corner property constitutes an obtrusive feature and over development of the property which is out of character with the surrounding area and the St. Paul's Church Conservation Area and harms the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers through loss of outlook. It is therefore contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines and Supplementary Planning Guidance relating to St Paul's Church Conservation Area.
description: Retention of existing detached rear garage and front porch and canopy to house.
